What each test requires

P01 · 11 RESEARCH CHECKS · 4 CRITICAL

Company-level market cap

Reconcile share classes, point-in-time membership, competing leaders and synchronized closing values.

Reference status: Historical source pack incomplete.

P02 · 12 RESEARCH CHECKS · 5 CRITICAL

Twenty-manager consensus

Rebuild twenty top-ten lists from the correct 13F filings; deduplicate managers, instruments and voting counts.

Reference status: Historical source pack incomplete.

P03 · 14 RESEARCH CHECKS · 7 CRITICAL

Congress disclosure trigger

Use public disclosure time, distinct member identities and transaction-range lower bounds.

Reference status: Historical source pack incomplete.

P04 · 13 RESEARCH CHECKS · 5 CRITICAL

Insider clusters

Verify membership and distinct CEO/CFO plus director open-market buyers using footnotes.

Reference status: Historical source pack incomplete.

P05 · 14 RESEARCH CHECKS · 5 CRITICAL

Estimate revisions

Reconstruct historical strength, breadth and momentum with the declared score and data vintage.

Reference status: Historical source pack incomplete.

P06 · 13 RESEARCH CHECKS · 5 CRITICAL

Oligopoly quality

Match concentration and leadership to one market definition; reconcile ROIC, cash flow and pricing power.

Reference status: Historical source pack incomplete.

P07 · 13 RESEARCH CHECKS · 5 CRITICAL

AI bottlenecks

Compare five constraints, establish which actually binds, then connect three firms to cash flow.

Reference status: Historical source pack incomplete.

P08 · 14 RESEARCH CHECKS · 7 CRITICAL

Lobbying to revenue

Deduplicate entities, rank comparable growth first, then confirm the top five without backfilling.

Reference status: Historical source pack incomplete.

P09 · 14 RESEARCH CHECKS · 8 CRITICAL

Four-regime rotation

Rebuild release-vintage signs, tie/zero handling, exact ETF maps and initialization.

Reference status: Partial BLS reference and supported-method calculations.

P10 · 22 RESEARCH CHECKS · 9 CRITICAL

Public robo-model policy

Separate supplied assumptions from approved disclosures; apply exact weights, cash triggers and fees.

Reference status: Historical source pack incomplete.

P11 · 17 RESEARCH CHECKS · 9 CRITICAL

Earnings-mention PageRank

Build a complete source-bound directed graph and independently verify scores with isolates and dangling nodes.

Reference status: Independent illustrative numerical contradiction; full corpus unverified.

Methodology and evidence

The original 157-check research review is retained unchanged: 1,727 criterion decisions and 5,181 AI votes. The new Jango assessment adds 157 adapted content checks and 88 separate operational checks, each independently reviewed three times: 735 additional votes. These counts measure review work, not independent trials or validated ground truth.
